title: Space, museum and scanned 3D models (NASA, Smithsonian, reference scans)
description: Real-object 3D models for space, science and history shorts: NASA's 3D Resources repository (GLB, BLEND, LWO; 'free and without copyright', with NASA brand rules), Smithsonian Open Access metadata (CC0), classic research scans, and the Sketchfab licence rules that govern most museum uploads.

items.title: nasa/NASA-3D-Resources
items.summary: NASA's collection of 3D models, textures, images and visualisations from Ames, Goddard, JPL and Johnson plus outside contributors; the README says the assets are free and without copyright.
items.licence: Public domain statement ('free and without copyright') + NASA usage guidelines
cautions: Follow NASA's media usage guidelines: do not use NASA insignia/logos or imply NASA endorsement.
Some models come from outside organisations (Ball Aerospace, DigitalSpace ...); check each folder's notes.
Some GLBs use KHR_draco_mesh_compression; decode before importing into tools without Draco support.

items.title: NASA 3D Resources: 3D Models folder
items.summary: One folder per model (spacecraft, rovers, suits, telescopes, supernova remnants ...), usually a .glb or .blend plus a .png preview.
items.licence: Public domain statement + NASA usage guidelines

items.title: NASA 3D: Apollo Lunar Module (GLB)
items.summary: Apollo Lunar Module as a 700 KB Draco-compressed GLB (134 meshes, 12 materials, WebP textures with PNG fallbacks) plus preview PNG.
items.licence: Public domain statement + NASA usage guidelines
cautions: Requires KHR_draco_mesh_compression and uses WebP textures; Blender's glTF importer handles both, other engines may need the file decoded first.

items.title: NASA 3D: Curiosity Rover (MSL)
items.summary: Curiosity rover as Blender files in Clean and Dirty versions with preview PNGs.
items.licence: Public domain statement + NASA usage guidelines
cautions: .blend only: export to GLB from Blender for Godot.

items.title: NASA 3D: Hubble Space Telescope (A)
items.summary: Hubble Space Telescope GLB with preview image.
items.licence: Public domain statement + NASA usage guidelines

items.title: NASA 3D: Astronaut
items.summary: Astronaut figure GLB with preview image; a ready narrator stand-in for space explainers.
items.licence: Public domain statement + NASA usage guidelines

items.title: NASA 3D: Gateway
items.summary: Gateway Core GLB plus a low lunar orbit backdrop image.
items.licence: Public domain statement + NASA usage guidelines

items.title: NASA 3D: Ben Franklin
items.summary: Model folder named 'Ben Franklin' (GLB, LWO and preview PNG); the folder gives no description, so check the preview before captioning what it depicts.
items.licence: Public domain statement + NASA usage guidelines
cautions: Subject not described in the folder; verify what the model shows before using it in a history claim.

items.title: Khronos glTF sample: Duck (GLB)
items.summary: 120 KB single-mesh textured GLB (COLLADA2GLTF export); a standard smoke test for importers and the glTF inspector.
cautions: Licence and credit live in the model's README; keep them with the file.

items.title: Smithsonian/OpenAccess metadata
items.summary: 11 million+ Smithsonian Open Access metadata records as line-delimited JSON (CC0); the archive has moved to AWS and the repo is read-only. Use it to find CC0 objects and their media links.
cautions: CC0 applies only to records/media marked Open Access; other Smithsonian media keep their own rights.
Images of people and trademarks can carry rights CC0 does not clear.

items.title: alecjacobson/common-3d-test-models
items.summary: Famous research meshes (Stanford Bunny, Dragon, Happy Buddha, Lucy, Spot, Suzanne, Utah Teapot, Nefertiti ...) with source and first appearance per model.
items.licence: Per model; the table lists sources, not licences
cautions: No licence column: treat each model as 'rights unknown' until you check its original source; several have research-only histories.

items.title: Sketchfab help: Crediting users for 3D model downloads
items.summary: How to credit Sketchfab creators for CC-licensed downloads (most museum scans on Sketchfab are CC BY, CC BY-NC or CC0 per model).

items.title: Sketchfab help: Choosing your model's licence
items.summary: Explains the CC licence options on downloadable models (CC0, CC BY, BY-SA, BY-ND, BY-NC ...) and what each allows.
cautions: BY-NC models are not usable in monetised videos; BY-ND models cannot be modified.

items.title: Sketchfab help: Store licence usage FAQ
items.summary: Standard vs Editorial store licences; Editorial covers news/public-interest use only, and purchased models may never be offered for download to others.

items.title: Sketchfab blog: 600,000 free 3D models
items.summary: Sketchfab post about its free downloadable model library (count as stated in the post title).
